title: policy.json: reports
description: When a progress report is due (design parts 12.2 and 13.3). A report is due when enough has changed, when the owner is present or the machine is idle and something changed, or when too long has passed without one. `hitld cadence due` reads these and the ledger; it holds no timer. A threshold of 0 is off.

every_merges.description: Due once this many items have merged since the last report.

every_decisions.description: Due once this many decisions have been asked or answered, or calls logged, since the last report.

every_merged_estimate_tokens.description: Due once the items merged since the last report add up to this many estimate tokens: the value accumulated, measured by the size the work was estimated at.

when_owner_writes.description: Due when the owner writes in the chief of staff's session and at least min_changes have accumulated: the owner is there to read it.

when_idle.description: Due when the machine is idle (no executor running, load low) and at least min_changes have accumulated: nothing is competing for the machine.

min_changes.description: The fewest changes (merges plus decisions) that make a report worth sending on the owner's presence or an idle machine.

silence_max_hours.description: The longest the owner goes without a report while a run is active or something changed. A ceiling on silence, not a schedule: a report sent for any other reason restarts it.

dashboard_plan_states.description: The item states the dashboard's plan graph draws by default (design part 12.1.3). Proposed items have their own view, Proposals; the full graph stays in work/views/items-graph.md.

dashboard_plan_max_items.description: The most items the dashboard's plan graph draws. Past it, the graph is cut by project: whole projects in ID order until the next would pass the limit, and the rest are named under it.
